class.name: HEGoInputNodes
class.brief_description: Turns the Godot nodes wired into a [HEGoNode3D] into HEGo input nodes.
class.description: Which input node a Godot node needs depends on its type: paths become curve inputs, meshes and CSG shapes become geometry inputs, and a [HEGoGraphInput3D] becomes points and polyline primitives. Other addons add kinds of their own, such as terrains, through [HEGoInputHandler], which is consulted first. The node path of the source is always sent along as [code]_hego_node_path[/code] so an HDA can tell its inputs apart.

method.name: extension_handlers
method.description: The input handlers other addons provide: one instance of every global class that extends [HEGoInputHandler]. Rescanned whenever the project's class list changes, so an addon installed in an open editor is picked up without a restart.

method.name: handler_for
method.description: The extension handler that sends [param node], or null when HEGo handles it itself.

method.name: row_handlers
method.description: The extension handlers input row [param row] of [param host] uses: those that send one of the nodes it names, and those whose kind of settings it stores, so a row keeps its handler's rules while its node is renamed or deleted. [param row] is one entry of the input stash, [code]{inputs, settings}[/code].

method.name: resolve_paths
method.description: Expands input roots when settings.include_children is enabled. The stored paths remain compact; descendants are discovered again on every cook in scene order. Overlapping selections contribute each source once. Hidden authoring nodes are included, but this host's generated Outputs and CSG Boolean operands are not.

method.name: is_compatible_source
method.description: Whether a node supplies one of HEGo's supported input kinds. CSG assemblies bake from their root shape, including all of their Boolean children.

method.name: sync
method.description: Creates or updates the input node for the Godot node at [param input_node_path]. Pass the previous input node as [param existing_node] to reuse it when the source node still has the same type; pass null to always create a fresh one. Returns the input node to store, which is [param existing_node] itself when it was reused. [param settings] is the per-input settings dictionary from the input stash. curve_sample_length optionally controls Path3D upload spacing in metres. Missing, non-finite or non-positive values use the one-metre default. During a strict cook it also carries [code]_strict[/code] and the [code]_errors[/code] array failures are collected in; see [method HEGoAssetAgent.sync_inputs].

method.name: resolve_input_node
method.description: The node [param input_node_path] names, resolved the way input paths are: against the edited scene in the editor, against the running scene at runtime, and finally relative to [param host]. Null when nothing is there. Extensions use this to resolve paths an HDA writes into its output, so those behave exactly like the paths in the input stash.

constants.constant: Category this file logs under, shown in the session panel filter.
Value used for a surface that has no override material.
Spacing, in metres, a Path3D input is resampled at before it is sent to Houdini.
Key under which [method sync] passes an [HEGoInputHandler] the input path it resolved, as stored in the input stash, so the handler can send it as [constant NODE_PATH_ATTRIB].
Class every extension input handler extends.
